name: Agent management create and list operations
description: A manager can create a new agent account and see it appear in the agents list with correct details.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page and log in as manager
Navigate to the Agents management page
Click the Add Agent or Create button
Enter a name in the agent name field
Enter a valid email address in the email field
Enter a phone number in the phone field
Enter a password in the password field
Click the Save or Submit button
Verify the agent is created successfully and appears in the agents list with the entered name and email
